collection_contract.selection_order: Opening calendar date descending, then numeric control number descending; fixed newest subset before text enrichment
collection_contract.window: Computed once per search from an aware clock, converted to UTC; current UTC date plus previous six dates. Current day can be partial.
collection_contract.strict_decoding: Only JSON media type and identity/no content encoding; rejects duplicate JSON keys, nonfinite numbers, invalid envelopes, malformed required fields and alias conflicts.
collection_contract.transport: Verified-TLS SourceTransport; redirects and environment proxies disabled. Configured concurrency/rate, request deadline and remaining operation budget are enforced, with cooperative cancellation.
collection_contract.collection_admission: Existing source policy and persisted backoff govern scheduled/manual collection. Enrollment itself makes no provider request.

identity_and_persistence.native_posting_id: Positive non-boolean signed-64-bit control number, serialized as a string
identity_and_persistence.upstream_names: Nullable or changing agency/department display names remain separate source evidence; they do not determine identity.
identity_and_persistence.all_metadata_validation: Every row requires valid control/date, bounded collection/alias structure, occupational-series values and strict raw fingerprint before selection. Identical duplicates deduplicate; conflicting duplicates fail even if unselected.
identity_and_persistence.selected_metadata_validation: All selected rows require full native agency/department/announcement identity before the second request. No company-code inference or older-row backfill.
identity_and_persistence.all_text_validation: Every bounded text row requires selection keys, collection/alias structure and raw fingerprint; conflicting duplicate controls fail even when unselected.
identity_and_persistence.selected_text_validation: Every selected text row must match the complete native identity. Missing or mismatched selected text fails the search before domain persistence.
identity_and_persistence.unselected_text: Additional valid bulk rows are expected; they cannot create companies/postings/source items or fill a missing selected slot.
identity_and_persistence.snapshots: Complete joined native objects retained in immutable posting snapshots; repeat identity is stable and changed source content appends history.
identity_and_persistence.provenance: Allowlisted services.discovery.sources.usajobs.USAJobs.normalize producer and helper fingerprint are persisted with normalized values; historical readback survives parser changes/database reopen and rejects unrelated/unknown providers and tampered/missing capture.
identity_and_persistence.authority: USAJOBS is a listing origin. Collector agency/company records do not gain verified employer domains, first-party ATS tenancy or automatic submission authority from this feed.
identity_and_persistence.failure_atomicity: Search joins finish before domain-item persistence. Missing/mismatched/conflicting enrichment leaves prior domain rows intact; failure-health bookkeeping is separate.

normalization.text: Bounded sanitized announcement sections feed title, skills and requirements parsing; complete original provider records remain raw evidence.

dates.source_close_expire_date_precision: DATE only for valid ISO date, otherwise UNKNOWN

normalization.lifecycle_limits: CLOSED means an explicit no-longer-accepting-applications claim, not an inferred filled position. Null, unfamiliar status and Hiring complete remain UNKNOWN. Dates, rolling-window absence and empty batches do not establish lifecycle closure.
normalization.location: Only explicit structured locations inform geography. Exact full US state names/codes normalize only with explicit US country; multiple locations remain preserved without arbitrarily choosing a country.
normalization.remote: UNKNOWN; teleworkEligible is retained raw without inferring fully remote work, country eligibility or worldwide eligibility.
normalization.salary: Normalized salary amount/currency/period remain unknown/null; source salary fields remain raw claims.
